formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P9 — Five-Rival Support-Set Overlap Census, TS-Exclusive/Shared Move Attribution, Conditional Expected-Match Residualization, Pairwise Rival-Contrast Geometry, Method/Provenance Stratification, Leave-One-Rival Overlap Ablation & Rival-Specificity Audit
surviving_results: TS total solve excess is positive and stronger than H1/H2/H3/FS in all four pairwise solve-level contrasts.
Strict globally unique TS excess is positive but weak under solve-level sign-flip calibration.
Five-rival common-core degree-4 support carries 61.2% of total TS excess.
Cumulative low-overlap degree-0-to-2 TS excess is positive and survives method/provenance/cohort leave-one-group-out direction checks.
P4 and P7 campaign epochs both have positive low-overlap means, but neither epoch alone supplies strong independent confirmation.
interpretation: TS alignment is neither fully generic nor fully exclusive. It is common-core dominated with a smaller transport-stable peripheral specificity component.
next_scientific_problem: Locate the low-overlap TS component on the cube-state geometry itself: phase-1 lower bound, G1 membership, stage/progress position, and distance-to-constraint surfaces, and test whether its localization survives matched-state controls.
